question.question:
D1: Should the review cover all 7 dimensions?
Project/branch/task: reviewing PLAN.md, the marketing landing page plan, on main.
ELI10: I rated this plan 2/10 on design completeness. The biggest gaps: the main button looks no more important than the 'Learn more' link beside it, the headline is crammed 8px above the subhead, and all text is centered. On top of that the plan has no fonts, colors, mobile or accessibility specs. I'll walk the 7 design dimensions one at a time and ask you about each gap. The designer isn't installed, so there are no mockups this time.
Stakes if we pick wrong: narrowing the focus leaves mobile, accessibility and proof gaps undecided, and the engineer will guess at them.
Recommendation: A because your instructions say to review all seven, and a 2/10 plan has gaps in every one of them.
Completeness: A=10/10, B=6/10
Net: all 7 dimensions take more questions, but each gap gets decided.

options.label: A) All 7 dimensions (recommended)
options.description: ✅ Every dimension gets checked: hierarchy, states, journey, slop, system, responsive/a11y, decisions. ✅ Matches your stated instruction to review all seven dimensions. ❌ More questions, one per gap, before the plan is final.

options.label: B) Hero hierarchy only
options.description: ✅ Fast: only the CTA weight, h1 spacing and alignment get decided now. ✅ Fixes the three defects the plan already names in its text. ❌ Leaves mobile, accessibility, proof and tokens unspecified for the engineer.
